name: fhir_r4_search
description: Tool for FHIR Resource Search across supported types

search_parameters.description: Search parameters for the FHIR resource type being queried. Use the 'fhir_r4_get_search_parameters' tool to discover available search parameters for each resource type.

title: fhir_r4_search

name: fhir_r4_get_search_parameters
description: Tool to get available search parameters for a given FHIR Resource Type

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the available search parameters for the specified FHIR Resource Type

title: fhir_r4_get_search_parameters

name: fhir_r4_get_resource_schema
description: Tool to get the exact JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for a given FHIR Resource Type. Use this to see the full field structure before creating or updating a resource, or to interpret the shape of a resource returned by another tool.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the structure of the specified FHIR Resource Type

title: fhir_r4_get_resource_schema

name: fhir_r4_read
description: Read a specific FHIR resource by its resource type and logical ID

id.description: The logical ID of the resource to read

outputSchema.description: The requested FHIR resource. Shape depends on the resourceType - use the 'fhir_r4_get_resource_schema' tool to get its exact schema.

title: Read FHIR Resource

name: fhir_r4_vread
description: Read a specific version of a FHIR resource by resource type, logical ID, and version ID

id.description: The logical ID of the resource

outputSchema.description: The requested version of the FHIR resource. Shape depends on the resourceType - use the 'fhir_r4_get_resource_schema' tool to get its exact schema.

title: Version Read FHIR Resource

name: fhir_r4_create
description: Create a new FHIR resource. Provide the resourceType and the full resource body.

resource.description: The FHIR resource to create. Must include resourceType field matching the resourceType parameter.

outputSchema.description: The created FHIR resource with server-assigned ID. Shape depends on the resourceType - use the 'fhir_r4_get_resource_schema' tool to get its exact schema.

title: Create FHIR Resource

name: fhir_r4_update
description: Update an existing FHIR resource by its resource type and logical ID. Replaces the entire resource.

id.description: The logical ID of the resource to update

resource.description: The complete FHIR resource to replace the existing one. Must include resourceType and id fields.

outputSchema.description: The updated FHIR resource. Shape depends on the resourceType - use the 'fhir_r4_get_resource_schema' tool to get its exact schema.

title: Update FHIR Resource

name: fhir_r4_patch
description: Partially update a FHIR resource using JSON Patch (RFC 6902). Provide an array of patch operations.

id.description: The logical ID of the resource to patch

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) path to the target location

value.description: The value to apply (required for add, replace, test)

outputSchema.description: The patched FHIR resource. Shape depends on the resourceType - use the 'fhir_r4_get_resource_schema' tool to get its exact schema.

title: Patch FHIR Resource

name: fhir_r4_delete
description: Delete a FHIR resource by its resource type and logical ID

id.description: The logical ID of the resource to delete

title: Delete FHIR Resource

name: fhir_r4_history_instance
description: Retrieve the version history for a specific FHIR resource instance

id.description: The logical ID of the resource

_count.description: Maximum number of history entries to return

_since.description: Only include history entries after this instant (ISO 8601)

title: Instance History

name: fhir_r4_history_type
description: Retrieve the version history for all resources of a given type

_count.description: Maximum number of history entries to return

_since.description: Only include history entries after this instant (ISO 8601)

title: Type History

name: fhir_r4_capabilities
description: Retrieve the server's CapabilityStatement describing supported resources, operations, and search parameters

outputSchema.description: FHIR CapabilityStatement resource describing server capabilities

title: Server Capabilities

name: fhir_r4_transaction
description: Execute a FHIR transaction Bundle. All entries are processed atomically — if any entry fails, the entire transaction is rolled back.

bundle.description: A FHIR Bundle with type 'transaction'. Each entry must have a request element with method and url.

outputSchema.description: Transaction response Bundle with one entry per request, containing status and resource outcomes.

title: FHIR Transaction

name: fhir_r4_batch
description: Execute a FHIR batch Bundle. Each entry is processed independently — failures in one entry do not affect others.

bundle.description: A FHIR Bundle with type 'batch'. Each entry must have a request element with method and url.

outputSchema.description: Batch response Bundle with one entry per request, containing individual status codes and outcomes.

title: FHIR Batch
